summary: 账户抽象方面，ERC-7562（AA 验证规则）进入 Review；AnkushinDaniil 提出两个可选扩展，让 keystore 账户和 frame 账户共享同一授权步骤，并让密钥变更签名跨模型、跨链可移植。Hegotá 元 EIP-8081 合并 ACDE #245 的 DFI 决定。zsfelfoldi 认为递归 STARK 预授权（EIP-8288）会大幅降低无状态见证数据的链上成本，包括无信任日志索引的证明。

items.topic: 账户抽象标准的跨模型协作
items.title: ERC-7562 进入 Review
items.note: （forshtat）合并，这是 ERC-4337 账户抽象的验证规则。
items.note_en: (forshtat) was merged; it holds the validation rules for ERC-4337 account abstraction.

items.topic: 账户抽象标准的跨模型协作
items.title: EIP-8141：共享授权步骤的可选 sender 键控权限读取
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil，后关闭）。目前 `VERIFY` 帧只能读 `tx.sender` 的存储，无法读 keystore 合约里按账户键控、只有账户能写的权限记录，这阻碍了 keystore 账户与 frame 账户共享授权步骤。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: optional sender-keyed authority read for a shared authorization step
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil, later closed). A `VERIFY` frame can only read `tx.sender` storage today, so it cannot read an authority record in a keystore contract that is keyed to the account and writable only by it, which blocks keystore and frame accounts from sharing an authorization step.

items.topic: 账户抽象标准的跨模型协作
items.title: EIP-8130：可选的模型中立变更摘要
items.note: 签名摘要只绑定域、chainId、账户、actorId、新旧配置，不含签名者身份和交易，同一签名就能在 8130、其他原生 AA 模型或其他链上授权同一变更。
items.note_en: Where the signed digest binds only domain, chainId, account, actorId and the old and new config, with no signer identity or transaction, so the same signature authorizes the same change through 8130, another native AA model, or another chain.

items.title: ethresear.ch：用递归 STARK 和无信任日志索引扩容以太坊
items.note: 19:37（zsfelfoldi）。PQ 签名体积大，EIP-8288 的递归 STARK 预授权很可能成为升级路径；届时任何无状态可验证的见证数据的链上成本都大幅下降，包括基于 EIP-8304 索引表的日志查询证明。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: scaling Ethereum with recursive STARKs and the Trustless Log Index
items.note_en: 19:37 (zsfelfoldi). Because PQ signatures are large, EIP-8288's recursive STARK pre-authorization is a very likely upgrade path; then the onchain cost of any statelessly verifiable witness data drops sharply, including log query proofs based on EIP-8304's index tables.

keywords_en: shared authorization for frame and keystore accounts
recursive STARKs and the trustless log index
summary_en: On account abstraction, ERC-7562 (AA validation rules) moved to Review; AnkushinDaniil proposed two optional extensions letting keystore and frame accounts share one authorization step and making key change signatures portable across models and chains. The Hegotá meta EIP-8081 merged ACDE #245's DFI decisions. zsfelfoldi argued that recursive STARK pre-authorization (EIP-8288) would sharply cut the onchain cost of statelessly verifiable witness data, including trustless log index proofs.
